grimoire.title: Venue power outage
grimoire.text: Switch to emergency lighting, keep stairwells clear, do not use elevators, account for every attendee by sector, check life-safety systems, coordinate with building management.

grimoire.title: Fire / smoke evacuation
grimoire.text: Pull the alarm, evacuate via nearest stairwell, never elevators, assemble at the muster point, sweep sectors, report missing persons to fire services.

grimoire.title: Doctrine: EVACUATE
grimoire.text: Evacuate when the threat is mobile, there is structural compromise, or civilians are in the contact zone (pinned, trapped, exposed). Clear floors top-down and confirm empty.

grimoire.title: Flash flood
grimoire.text: Move to higher floors, cut power to flooded areas, never drive through water, stage pumps, track river gauges and official warnings.

grimoire.title: Cloud region outage runbook
grimoire.text: Confirm on the provider status page, freeze deploys, fail over to a healthy region, shed non-critical load, post a customer status update every 30 minutes, open a postmortem.

grimoire.title: Cyber incident / ransomware
grimoire.text: Isolate affected hosts, preserve evidence, rotate credentials, activate backups, notify legal and leadership, communicate without speculation.

# Power outage affects part of SF's Market Street after equipment damage
#### By Bay City News • Published July 4, 2026 • Updated on July 4, 2026 at 12:00 pm
About 90 Pacific Gas and Electric customers in San Francisco's Castro District were still without power on Saturday after a small outage struck a stretch of Market Street on Friday.

Traffic signals could be inoperable in the outage area, which included most of the 2200 block of Market Street and the blocks between Noe and Sanchez streets and from 15th to 16th streets, according to the San Francisco Department of Emergency Management.
